g.text: DURABLE COMMIT / ACTUAL WRITER BARRIER / ORIGINAL EXECUTION

text.tspan: Leader changes / lost replies / split publication / old permissions
Qualified original dispatch / one application / retained shared budgets
Not yet a durable committed record

Election alone does not isolate it
